profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm an effective problem solver and work well across teams to deliver high quality products and services.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Support builds and releases for Splunk Enterprise and UF
Responsible for GitHub Enterprise Operations
Work with OE Tools team to maintain Go-Monitor and evaluate deployment tools.
Mentored engineers and provided guidance for Value Stream app 
Build SCS Workshops and give training for new employee bootcamps
Co-authored and maintained SCS Python SDK
Maintainer of the SCloud command line tool
Lead the effort for integrating Splunkbase and App Inspect for auto-vetting.
Designed and Implemented Review Tool integration to help cut down on manual work.
Maintain App Insect CLI and App Inspect Web Services.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Write database persistence layer for a Proxy API server in golang  
Lead the effort for OpenStack Horizon and Keystone integration
Implemented features in Python for Openstack Trove projects
Participate in OpenStack community, contribute code and blue prints
Develop and support HP Cloud deployment tools built on Ansible and Nodejs
Wrote code in support of backend Ruby services for the HP Music team
Worked extensively with Amazon Web Services including EC2, SQS, S3, RDS
Coordinated with server, desktop and mobile teams to design, implement and test code
Worked with Cassandra DB and MySQL as the datastores for the services
Troubleshoot deployments and address software defects
Participated in planning activities and weekly meetings
Wrote documentation and release notes as necessary
Helped train new team members and provided assistance across the team
Contributed code to the IWS Ecommerce Java development team

positions.title: Java Web Application Engineer
positions.description:
Served as the lead developer on the Cerner project
Designed and implemented a RESTful Web Service using Spring 3 and JAXB
Updated SQL Server DB schema with new tables, columns and indexes
Wrote new DAO classes using Spring JDBC Template
Re-worked Spring Webflow application for client integration
Wrote a REST client using Jersey to test Web Services
Set up Java Dev environments with Eclipse, Maven, Spring, Hudson and SVN integration
Built tools and prototypes to assist the development effort
Deployed, branched and merged code base as needed
Interviewed Senior Java Developer candidates
Ran planning meetings for project sprints
Profiled Web Applications and Services using Visual VM

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with Hosted Authentication team to create a Single Sign-on solution
Created new screens for an Admin Tool using ExtJS and custom tag libraries
Implemented Spring 3 RESTful Controllers to create JSON Web Services
Maintained and refactored Java projects as needed
Wrote Unit Tests and Functional Tests using JUnit 3 and TestNG
Regularly interacted with developers across different teams
Participated in scrum and agile practices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Prototyped Spring 2.5 Framework for next generation product
Integrated streaming video service into the platform
Created Flex front end for Java Web Application using Cairngorm MVC Framework
Developed Dashboard screen for main Web Application
Implemented HTTP service layer and IBatis persistence classes
Wrote JUnit tests for new server side code, maintained existing code
Designed and coded an Amazon S3 web service client for media storage
Deployed new releases and site updates to QA and production
Fixed Java and Flex software defects and address support issues

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Wrote server side code in Java to support the web site and services
Implemented Web Service client for Amazon Flexible Payment Services
Worked within existing code base to create email notifications 
Wrote an API to support promotions and gift certificates for memberships
Created an Admin Tool using Adobe Flex 2 and Java Servlets
Provided excellent customer support for members and users

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Wrote Java and JSP for interactive web sites
Developed JUnit tests to validate basic method level functions
Created a proposal for source control and an automated deployment plan
Deployed updates and patches to UNIX servers running Apache Tomcat
Implemented email-to-a-friend feature for client sites
Wrote client side JavaScript and CSS for web pages as required
Designed and implemented a rating feature for a web site
Built a custom CMS tool for an portal page with JSP, Flash and HTML
Implemented file uploading, and XML data storage
Wrote backend code to support bulletin board feature

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
Wrote Java for RFScanning Project and Mobile Data Capture Group
Used Castor XML Data Binding to create configurable Data Collection Objects
Implemented log viewing and file downloading options for an Admin Tool
Used IBM DB2 Database via JDBC through a Persistence Layer
Created JUnit tests for new code and problematic areas of existing code
Wrote JSP and server side code within an enterprise level framework
Used Perl and Ant to automate build process in a UNIX environment
Implemented file handling and data processing for client updates 
Troubleshoot installs and deployments to Apache Tomcat Servers
Worked with QA Engineers to investigate and resolve defects

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description:
Created a prototype for an inventory tool using the LAMP stack
Wrote Perl scripts to load test VPIM, an SMTP voice messaging protocol
Developed and executed test plans for various client, server, and web apps
Submitted and verified defects for Voice Messaging Systems and VoIP integration
Attended weekly QA and DEV meetings to discuss project issues and milestones
Regularly assisted Tech Support, Tech Publications and Field Test Coordinator
Participated in bug walks to prioritize defects and follow up on resolutions

positions.title: Data Analyst / Research Scientist
positions.description:
Analyzed SNP DNA data using Polyphred, Phred, Phrap, Consed
Used computational tools to facilitate gene annotation, and data submission
